title: Login
description: As a registered user I want to log in with my email and password so that I can access my dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria:
Valid email and password take the user to the dashboard
Wrong password shows the error 'Invalid email or password'
Email and password are required
The account is locked for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts
The password field masks the input

title: Sign up
description: As a new visitor I want to create an account so that I can save my work.
acceptanceCriteria:
Name, email and password are required
Email must be unique; a duplicate email shows an error
Password needs at least 8 characters with one letter and one digit
After sign up the user is logged in and sees the dashboard
Terms of service must be accepted before submitting

title: Password reset
description: As a user who forgot my password I want to reset it by email so that I can regain access.
acceptanceCriteria:
Entering a registered email sends a reset link
An unknown email shows the same confirmation message to avoid revealing accounts
The reset link expires after 30 minutes
The reset link can be used only once
The new password must meet the password policy

title: Cart checkout
description: As a shopper I want to check out the items in my cart so that I can buy them.
acceptanceCriteria:
Checkout shows the item list, quantities and order total including tax
Shipping address is required
Card payment is validated before the order is placed
A declined card shows an error and the cart is kept
An empty cart cannot be checked out
A successful order shows a confirmation with an order number

title: File upload
description: As a user I want to upload a profile document so that it is attached to my account.
acceptanceCriteria:
Only PDF, PNG and JPG files are accepted
Files larger than 5 MB are rejected with an error message
A progress bar shows upload progress
The uploaded file appears in the documents list with its name and size
The user can cancel an upload in progress
